companyIntro.name: Sentinel Security Operations
companyIntro.mission: Detect, contain and learn from cyber incidents faster than attackers can move.
companyIntro.culture: Calm under pressure, precise in notes. If it is not logged it did not happen.

projectBackground.name: 24/7 SOC for Retail Group
projectBackground.context: Several staff report a suspicious email and the login logs show a burst of failed attempts on one account.

manager.name: Karl Tamm
manager.note: Calm and precise. Contain first, explain later, and write everything down.

assignment.title: Triage and contain the incident
assignment.brief: Prioritise the alerts, compute the attack rate, choose containment steps and write the shift handover.

tasks.title: First Phishing Step
tasks.prompt: Several staff clicked a link in a suspicious email. What is the first priority?
options: Identify who clicked and reset their credentials, then block the domain
tasks.reasoning: Containing exposed credentials limits damage before deeper analysis.
tasks.mistake: Waiting lets the attacker use stolen credentials.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Attack Rate
tasks.prompt: 1,200 failed logins occurred over 20 minutes on one account. What is the average attempts per minute?
tasks.reasoning: Rate distinguishes brute force from a mistyped password.
tasks.mistake: Absolute counts without time are meaningless.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Least Privilege
tasks.prompt: The compromised admin account could reach the finance share. Which principle reduces this risk?
options: Least privilege — give only the access required
tasks.reasoning: Limiting access limits what an attacker can reach.
tasks.mistake: Broad access turns one account takeover into a major breach.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Containment Steps
options: Block the attacking IP and phishing domain
Disable or lock the targeted account
Force password reset and MFA enrolment
Tell the attacker you've detected them
tasks.reasoning: Containment stops activity while preserving evidence.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: CIA Triad
tasks.prompt: Ransomware that encrypts files primarily harms which property?
tasks.reasoning: Encrypted files cannot be accessed, so availability is lost (data may also be stolen).
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Shift Handover
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-5 sentence incident handover note.
tasks.modelAnswer: At 14:10 three users clicked a phishing link to a look-alike login page; their passwords were reset and the domain blocked. Between 14:20 and 14:40 an admin account received 1,200 failed logins (60 per minute); the account was locked and the source IP blocked. No successful login was observed. The admin account can reach the finance share, so a log review is pending. Next shift should confirm MFA enrolment and monitor for reuse of the domain.
tasks.reasoning: A good handover has time, impact, actions, open items and next steps.
tasks.mistake: An incomplete handover makes the next shift repeat work.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Phish That Wasn't Reported
caseStudy.background: A user clicked a phishing link and said nothing for two days. The attacker used the credentials to forward invoices and redirect a payment of £180,000.
caseStudy.challenges: No easy reporting path and a culture of blame.
questions: Why did silence help the attacker?
caseStudy.solution: Sentinel introduced a one-click report button, blame-free messaging and payment call-back checks.

options: Reset credentials and block the domain
